title: 自定义调试器开发
html:
自定义调试器开发

核心概念

开发自定义调试器的核心是实现一个 Debug Adapter——一个遵循 DAP 协议的中间层程序，它将编辑器的调试请求翻译为特定运行时或调试协议的操作。@vscode/debugadapter 库提供了 Node.js 环境下的基础框架，开发者只需继承 DebugSession 类并实现各个请求处理方法。

flowchart LR
    A[VS Code 调试 UI] --> B[DAP 协议层]
    B --> C[自定义 Debug Adapter]
    C --> D{目标运行时}
    D --> E[Node.js Inspector]
    D --> F[Chrome DevTools Protocol]
    D --> G[GDB/LLDB]
    D --> H[自定义协议]

不同调试场景的实现策略：

场景 适配器实现 目标协议 复杂度
JavaScript/Node.js js-debug V8 Inspector Protocol 高
Python debugpy DAP（原生实现） 中
C/C++ cpptools GDB/LLDB MI 高
Go delve Delve API 中
自定义语言 自行实现 自定义协议 取决于运行时
Mock 调试器 教学用途 无真实运行时 低

DebugSession 基础骨架

使用 @vscode/debugadapter 创建 Debug Adapter 的基本结构：

import {
  DebugSession,
  InitializedEvent,
  StoppedEvent,
  OutputEvent,
  TerminatedEvent,
  Thread,
  StackFrame,
  Scope,
  Source,
  Variable,
} from '@vscode/debugadapter';
import { DebugProtocol } from '@vscode/debugprotocol';

class MyDebugSession extends DebugSession {
  private static THREAD_ID = 1;
  private sourceFile = '';
  private currentLine = 0;
  private breakpoints = new Map<string, number[]>();
  private variables = new Map<string, string>();

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.setDebuggerLinesStartAt1(true);
    this.setDebuggerColumnsStartAt1(true);
  }

  protected initializeRequest(
    response: DebugProtocol.InitializeResponse,
    args: DebugProtocol.InitializeRequestArguments,
  ): void {
    response.body = response.body ?? {};
    response.body.supportsConfigurationDoneRequest = true;
    response.body.supportsEvaluateForHovers = true;
    response.body.supportsConditionalBreakpoints = true;
    response.body.supportsStepBack = false;

    this.sendResponse(response);
    this.sendEvent(new InitializedEvent());
  }

  protected launchRequest(
    response: DebugProtocol.LaunchResponse,
    args: DebugProtocol.LaunchRequestArguments & { program: string },
  ): void {
    this.sourceFile = args.program;
    this.currentLine = 1;
    this.startDebugging();
    this.sendResponse(response);
  }

  protected disconnectRequest(
    response: DebugProtocol.DisconnectResponse,
    args: DebugProtocol.DisconnectArguments,
  ): void {
    this.cleanup();
    this.sendResponse(response);
  }

  private startDebugging(): void {
    this.sendEvent(new StoppedEvent('entry', MyDebugSession.THREAD_ID));
  }

  private cleanup(): void {
    this.breakpoints.clear();
    this.variables.clear();
  }
}

DebugSession.run(MyDebugSession);
flowchart TD
    A[VS Code] --> B[initialize]
    B --> C[initializeRequest<br/>声明能力]
    C --> D[launch/attach]
    D --> E[launchRequest<br/>启动目标程序]
    E --> F[InitializedEvent]
    F --> G[setBreakpoints]
    G --> H[configurationDone]
    H --> I[开始执行]
    I --> J{命中断点?}
    J -->|是| K[StoppedEvent]
    J -->|否| L[继续执行]
    K --> M[等待用户操作]

断点管理实现

断点管理是调试器最核心的功能之一：

protected setBreakPointsRequest(
  response: DebugProtocol.SetBreakpointsResponse,
  args: DebugProtocol.SetBreakpointsArguments
): void {
  const path = args.source.path ?? "";
  const clientLines = args.breakpoints?.map((bp) => bp.line) ?? [];

  const verifiedBreakpoints: DebugProtocol.Breakpoint[] = clientLines.map(
    (line, index) => {
      const verified = this.isValidBreakpointLocation(path, line);
      return {
        id: index + 1,
        verified,
        line: verified ? line : undefined,
        message: verified ? undefined : "此位置不可设置断点",
        source: args.source,
      };
    }
  );

  this.breakpoints.set(path, clientLines.filter((_, i) => verifiedBreakpoints[i].verified));

  response.body = { breakpoints: verifiedBreakpoints };
  this.sendResponse(response);
}

private isValidBreakpointLocation(path: string, line: number): boolean {
  return line > 0;
}

private checkBreakpoint(): boolean {
  const breakpointLines = this.breakpoints.get(this.sourceFile) ?? [];
  return breakpointLines.includes(this.currentLine);
}

条件断点和日志断点需要额外的评估逻辑：

断点类型 触发条件 行为
普通断点 执行到指定行 暂停执行
条件断点 条件表达式为 true 暂停执行
Hit Count 断点 命中次数满足条件 暂停执行
日志断点 执行到指定行 输出日志不暂停

执行控制与状态查询

步进、继续等执行控制命令的实现：

protected continueRequest(
  response: DebugProtocol.ContinueResponse,
  args: DebugProtocol.ContinueArguments
): void {
  this.executeUntilBreakpointOrEnd();
  this.sendResponse(response);
}

protected nextRequest(
  response: DebugProtocol.NextResponse,
  args: DebugProtocol.NextArguments
): void {
  this.currentLine++;
  this.sendResponse(response);

  if (this.isEndOfProgram()) {
    this.sendEvent(new TerminatedEvent());
  } else if (this.checkBreakpoint()) {
    this.sendEvent(new StoppedEvent("step", MyDebugSession.THREAD_ID));
  } else {
    this.sendEvent(new StoppedEvent("step", MyDebugSession.THREAD_ID));
  }
}

protected threadsRequest(response: DebugProtocol.ThreadsResponse): void {
  response.body = {
    threads: [new Thread(MyDebugSession.THREAD_ID, "Main Thread")],
  };
  this.sendResponse(response);
}

protected stackTraceRequest(
  response: DebugProtocol.StackTraceResponse,
  args: DebugProtocol.StackTraceArguments
): void {
  const frames: StackFrame[] = [
    new StackFrame(
      0,
      "main",
      new Source("program", this.sourceFile),
      this.currentLine,
      1
    ),
  ];

  response.body = {
    stackFrames: frames,
    totalFrames: frames.length,
  };
  this.sendResponse(response);
}

变量和作用域的查询实现：

private variableHandles = new Map<number, string>();
private nextVariableHandle = 1;

protected scopesRequest(
  response: DebugProtocol.ScopesResponse,
  args: DebugProtocol.ScopesArguments
): void {
  const localHandle = this.nextVariableHandle++;
  this.variableHandles.set(localHandle, "local");

  const globalHandle = this.nextVariableHandle++;
  this.variableHandles.set(globalHandle, "global");

  response.body = {
    scopes: [
      new Scope("Local", localHandle, false),
      new Scope("Global", globalHandle, true),
    ],
  };
  this.sendResponse(response);
}

protected variablesRequest(
  response: DebugProtocol.VariablesResponse,
  args: DebugProtocol.VariablesArguments
): void {
  const scopeType = this.variableHandles.get(args.variablesReference);
  const vars: Variable[] = [];

  if (scopeType === "local") {
    for (const [name, value] of this.variables) {
      vars.push(new Variable(name, value, 0));
    }
  }

  response.body = { variables: vars };
  this.sendResponse(response);
}

    A[stopped Event] --> B[UI 请求 threads]

表达式求值

Watch 窗口和 Hover 的表达式求值通过 evaluate 请求实现：

protected evaluateRequest(
  response: DebugProtocol.EvaluateResponse,
  args: DebugProtocol.EvaluateArguments
): void {
  const expression = args.expression;
  const context = args.context;

  let result: string;
  let variablesReference = 0;

  if (this.variables.has(expression)) {
    result = this.variables.get(expression)!;
  } else {
    try {
      result = this.evaluateExpression(expression);
    } catch (e) {
      result = `Error: ${(e as Error).message}`;
    }
  }

  response.body = {
    result,
    variablesReference,
  };
  this.sendResponse(response);
}
context 值 触发场景 期望行为
watch Watch 面板 持续求值
hover 鼠标悬停 快速求值
repl Debug Console 交互式求值
clipboard 复制值 格式化输出

小结

  • 自定义 Debug Adapter 通过继承 DebugSession 类并实现各请求处理方法来构建
  • 断点管理支持普通、条件、Hit Count 和日志四种类型
  • 变量查询采用引用-展开模式（variablesReference），支持复杂对象的懒加载
  • 表达式求值通过 context 参数区分 watch、hover、repl 等不同使用场景
  • DebugSession.run() 启动适配器的事件循环，处理 stdio 通信
